objective: The CEO result page (EngineeringResult) reports how many developer attempts a job has used (developer_attempts) but never how many remain against the work order's own authorized ceiling, so reading the page requires separately looking up max_developer_attempts and subtracting by hand every time. Add a field to EngineeringResult reporting the developer attempts remaining, populated from the job's own existing corrections_remaining property (do not reimplement the arithmetic), and show it on the CEO page's text rendering next to the existing developer attempts line.
